decisions.decision: scene_chase orchestrates rules, player, obstacles, pursuer, HUD and audio without owning their internal state
decisions.reason: keeps scene transitions and VDP ownership explicit
decisions.fallback: disable optional FX before merging modules

decisions.decision: create six obstacle slots and all FX sprites at scene enter
decisions.reason: no heap or surprise VRAM allocation during gameplay
decisions.fallback: reduce active pool before increasing SPR_initEx

decisions.decision: scene_chase owns signed 224-line tables for BG_A and BG_B and commits both with DMA_QUEUE
decisions.reason: HSCROLL_LINE requires a complete table for both planes

decisions.decision: hero and pursuer body cannot request an animation frame upload on the same frame
decisions.reason: preserves VBlank headroom for line scroll, SAT and dust

decisions.decision: BUTTON_C debug toggle and global debug overlay are removed from delivery flow
decisions.reason: prevents WINDOW and text-plane ownership conflicts
decisions.fallback: debug-only build flag outside delivery ROM

decisions.decision: runtime probe consumes a checksum-valid one-shot SBIS scene bootstrap from SRAM
decisions.reason: allows canonical BlastEm capture of a target scene without player-visible debug input
decisions.fallback: navigate the front-end with a validated BlastEm input script

decisions.decision: XGM2 exclusively owns FM and PSG music; project SFX use only PCM_CH2 and PCM_CH3 through AUDIO_playPCM
decisions.reason: prevents direct PSG writes and the former PCM_CH1 score loop from conflicting with the XGM2 driver
decisions.fallback: drop optional PCM_CH3 cues before changing channel ownership

decisions.decision: AUD2 telemetry is exported at SRAM offset 0x800 and bound to the captured ROM hash
decisions.reason: proves music/SFX simultaneity, accepted requests and XGM2 load without relying on intent
decisions.fallback: block the audio claim when AUD2 is absent or hash identity is stale
